items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: Him and I and Black Benny work together. Years, that he liked.

ctx.x: Better than Rene for ragtime? Oh no, no. He wasn't. They were... I mean they both had top notch bands. Uh huh. Rene was a high note man, just like I was. High note. They talk that every day right now in the city. They talk that by Mueller's ball, I'll bum every day right now. Uh huh. That's Rene and Ivy. Now I ain't live trumpet players on the order. Now I'm Perez playing next door to me on Iverville, between Burgundy and Ramport, back in the the Lauderdale Theater. Red Happen was playing with Jordan Overshirt…
Willie Humphrey, I'll talk to Corsier.
